6 /-! Every cut-tree edge has a pair of planar metric triangles. Their
7 base length and all radial lengths are proved from the actual surface.
8 Identification of the full strips with these triangles is a further step. -/
9 
10 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
11 
12 open Set
13 
14 /-- A planar base and two source copies with the exact intrinsic radial distance profile. -/
15 structure CutEdgeMetricModel {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
16     (T : P.CutLocusTree a) {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) where
17   left : Plane
18   right : Plane
19   first : Plane
20   second : Plane
21   base_length : dist left right = dist (u : Space) (v : Space)
22   distinct_sources : first ≠ second
23   first_distances : ∀ t : unitInterval,
24     dist first (AffineMap.lineMap left right (t : ℝ)) = P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t)
25   second_distances : ∀ t : unitInterval,
26     dist second (AffineMap.lineMap left right (t : ℝ)) = P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t)
27 
28 namespace CutEdgeMetricModel
29 
30 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
31   {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} (M : CutEdgeMetricModel T edge)
32 
33 theorem base_different : M.left ≠ M.right := by
34   intro same
35   have zero : dist (u : Space) (v : Space) = 0 := by rw [← M.base_length, same, dist_self]
36   exact edge.ne (Subtype.ext (dist_eq_zero.mp zero))
37 
38 theorem left_distances : dist M.first M.left = dist M.second M.left := by
39   simpa using
40     (M.first_distances 0).trans (M.second_distances 0).symm
41 
42 theorem right_distances : dist M.first M.right = dist M.second M.right := by
43   simpa using
44     (M.first_distances 1).trans (M.second_distances 1).symm
45 
46 /-- Neither planar triangle is degenerate. -/
47 theorem noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({M.first, M.left, M.right} : Set Plane) ∧
48     ¬ Collinear ℝ ({M.second, M.left, M.right} : Set Plane) :=
49   ⟨bisector_base_noncollinear _ _ _ _ M.distinct_sources M.base_different M.left_distances M.right_distances,
50     bisector_base_noncollinear _ _ _ _ M.distinct_sources.symm M.base_different M.left_distances.symm M.right_distances.symm⟩
51 
52 /-- Construct the metric model in specified face or hinge coordinates. -/
53 noncomputable def fromAffineSources (place : Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane) (p q : Plane) (different : p ≠ q)
54     (base_length : dist (place u) (place v) = dist (u : Space) (v : Space))
55     (profiles : ∀ t : unitInterval,
56       P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t) = dist p (place (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t)) ∧
57       P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t) = dist q (place (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t))) :
58     CutEdgeMetricModel T edge := by
59   refine ⟨place u, place v, p, q, base_length, different, ?_, ?_⟩
60   · intro t
61     simpa only [← AffineMap.apply_lineMap] using (profiles t).1.symm
62   · intro t
63     simpa only [← AffineMap.apply_lineMap] using (profiles t).2.symm
64 
65 /-- Affine coordinates of a face or joined hinge supply a metric model. -/
66 theorem of_affine_sources (place : Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane) (p q : Plane) (different : p ≠ q)
67     (base_length : dist (place u) (place v) = dist (u : Space) (v : Space))
68     (profiles : ∀ t : unitInterval,
69       P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t) = dist p (place (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t)) ∧
70       P.surfaceDist a (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t) = dist q (place (T.closedEdgeTarget edge t))) :
71     Nonempty (CutEdgeMetricModel T edge) := ⟨fromAffineSources place p q different base_length profiles⟩
72 
73 theorem base_first_noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({M.left, M.right, M.first} : Set Plane) := by
74   rw [show ({M.left, M.right, M.first} : Set Plane) = {M.first, M.left, M.right} by
75     ext x; simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]; tauto]
76   exact M.noncollinear.1
77 
78 theorem base_second_noncollinear : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({M.left, M.right, M.second} : Set Plane) := by
79   rw [show ({M.left, M.right, M.second} : Set Plane) = {M.second, M.left, M.right} by
80     ext x; simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]; tauto]
81   exact M.noncollinear.2
82 
83 end CutEdgeMetricModel
84 
85 namespace SixVertexGraph
86 
87 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
88   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
89     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
90 
91 include graph small_faces in
92 /-- Every actual cut-tree edge has its two metric triangles, including edges along original hinges. -/
93 theorem exists_cut_edge_metric_model (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
94     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) : Nonempty (CutEdgeMetricModel T edge) := by
95   obtain ⟨S⟩ := graph.exists_cut_edge_strips small_faces a T edge
96   rcases T.open_edge_facet_type edge with ⟨F, contained, unique⟩ | ⟨F, G, shared, contained⟩
97   · obtain ⟨p, _, q, _, different, _, profiles⟩ := graph.cut_edge_face_sources small_faces a T edge S F unique
98     apply CutEdgeMetricModel.of_affine_sources (P.faceCoordinates F) p q different ?_ profiles
99     exact P.faceCoordinates_rigid F u (by simpa only [T.closedEdgeTarget_zero] using contained 0)
100       v (by simpa only [T.closedEdgeTarget_one] using contained 1)
101   · obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
102     obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
103     obtain ⟨chart⟩ := exists_edge_folding facets F G shared
104     obtain ⟨p, _, q, _, different, _, profiles⟩ := chart.cut_edge_hinge_sources graph small_faces shared a T edge S
105       (fun t => contained (interiorTime t))
106     apply CutEdgeMetricModel.of_affine_sources chart.left p q different ?_ profiles
107     exact chart.left_rigid u (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ (by simpa only [T.closedEdgeTarget_zero] using (contained 0).1))
108       v (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ (by simpa only [T.closedEdgeTarget_one] using (contained 1).1))
109 
110 end SixVertexGraph
111 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
